t: This is 170 to 178 Holland Park Avenue, a building in Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by Robert Cantwell, a British architect who laid out the Norland Estate in Holland Park. He designed Norland Square and Royal Crescent there, and on Holland Park Avenue itself he designed terraced houses at numbers 2 to 6 and number 10. So you are standing in an area that Cantwell shaped in several ways.
